app.name: iLovePDF Clone
app.tagline: Every PDF tool you need in one place
app.description: Merge, split, compress, convert, watermark, protect and unlock PDF files — fast, free, and easy to use.

hero.subtitle: Merge, split, compress, convert, watermark and protect PDF files. Most tools process on our server in-memory and never store anything; PDF to JPG and Organize render thumbnails directly in your browser.

cards.merge: Combine PDFs in the order you want with the easiest PDF merger available.
cards.split: Separate one page or a whole set for easy conversion into independent PDF files.
cards.compress: Reduce file size while optimizing for maximal PDF quality.
cards.rotate: Rotate your PDFs the way you need them — by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
cards.jpgToPdf: Convert JPG images to PDF in seconds. Easily adjust orientation and margins.
cards.pdfToJpg: Convert every page of your PDF into a high-quality JPG image. Renders in your browser — file never leaves your device.
cards.watermark: Stamp an image or text over your PDF in seconds — choose typography, transparency and rotation.
cards.protect: Protect PDF files with a password. Encrypt PDF documents to prevent unauthorized access.
cards.unlock: Remove PDF password security, giving you the freedom to use your PDFs.
cards.organize: Sort pages of your PDF file however you like. Delete PDF pages or add PDF pages.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.body: Pick a tool above, drop in your files, and we'll process them in seconds.

built.title: Built for speed
built.body: Most tools run on a Cloudflare Worker using pdf-lib and pure-JS Web Crypto for encryption. PDF to JPG and Organize thumbnails render directly in your browser via pdf.js.

private.title: Privacy first
private.body: Files are streamed into memory, processed, and immediately returned. Nothing is written to disk or stored.

common.dropFiles: Drag & drop files here, or click to browse
